overview.title: Related Manning titles (advertisement)
overview.main_topic: Publisher's list of related Manning books.
overview.central_idea: A back-matter advertisement listing four other Manning titles; it contains no deep-learning content from this book.
overview.importance: Not part of the book's teaching content; it can be skipped. It may be useful only as a reading list.
learning_objectives: Recognize that this page is publisher back matter, not book content

summary:
This page, after the index, is a **publisher's advertisement** headed "RELATED MANNING TITLES". It lists four books with ISBN, page count, price and publication date:

- *Grokking Artificial Intelligence Algorithms* by Rishal Hurbans (392 pages, July 2020)
- *Deep Learning and the Game of Go* by Max Pumperla and Kevin Ferguson, foreword by Thore Graepel (384 pages, January 2019)
- *Transfer Learning for Natural Language Processing* by Paul Azunre (272 pages, July 2021)
- *Deep Learning with JavaScript* by Shanqing Cai, Stanley Bileschi, Eric D. Nielsen and François Chollet, foreword by Nikhil Thorat and Daniel Smilkov (560 pages, January 2020)

It ends with "For ordering information, go to www.manning.com". The book's own content ends with the index on PDF 645.
takeaways: This is a publisher advertisement page, not part of the book's content.
One listed title, Deep Learning with JavaScript, is co-authored by François Chollet.
